feeds.description: The Bujinkan Dōjō is an organization composed of 9 schools (Ryu Ha) of martial arts. In Bujinkan Terrassa you have martial arts classes from Bujinkan as well as personal defense, Tai Chi, Qi gong.

feeds.title: Bujinkan Roselle Dojo
feeds.description: The Bujinkan Roselle Dojo offers is a Traditional Japanese Dojo found in the Western Suburbs of Chicago. The Roselle Dojo offers education and training in multiple martial art systems and strategies.

feeds.title: Namiryu Dojo Blog
feeds.description: The focus of Namiryu Dojois is the transmission of the martial arts taught by the Bujinkan Dojo in Japan. This includes the study of nine feudal-era samurai ryuha such as Togakure Ryu, Takagi Yoshin Ryu, Kukishin Ryu, Gyokko Ryu, Koto Ryu and more.

feeds.description: Bujinkan is not a sport, the techniques are designed to do damage and many of the techniques we do in Bujinkan is dangerous. Follow the blog to find more on Bujikan by Mats Hjelm.

feeds.title: Bujinkan Brecon Dojo
feeds.description: Bujinkan Brecon Dojo, a Powys (Mid Wales) based martial arts club that promotes the art of Bujinkan Budo Taijutsu also known as Ninjutsu as taught by Soke Masaaki Hatsumi at the Honbu dojo in Japan. Bujinkan budo taijutsu offers a very effective and practical approach to the fighting arts as well as self defense.
